    14  `M`-orbit of every point `x : α` is dense. We also provide an additive version of this definition
    15  and prove some basic facts about minimal actions.

    31  /-- An action of an additive monoid `M` on a topological space is called *minimal* if the `M`-orbit
    32  of every point `x : α` is dense. -/
    33  class AddAction.IsMinimal (M α : Type*) [AddMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace α] [AddAction M α] :
    34      Prop where
    35    dense_orbit : ∀ x : α, Dense (AddAction.orbit M x)
